actual_claim_wordings.186: A method of constructing a candidate-material record, comprising selecting a constituent support and composition basis; assigning positive normalized target fractions whose sum is one; recording structural, preparation, measurement and property fields; and recording an evidence status for each field without treating an unresolved field as a successful preparation.
actual_claim_wordings.197: The method of claim 186, comprising recording a property scenario with a baseline material and state, controlled change, proposed response, mechanism, conditions, discriminating test and evidence status.
actual_claim_wordings.198: The method of claim 197, comprising recording a credible alternative response and its mechanism as a separate conditional hypothesis, rather than asserting opposite responses for the same specimen under identical conditions.
actual_claim_wordings.199: The method of claim 186, comprising labeling attributed source teachings ESTABLISHED, stated mathematical or model results CALCULATED, unperformed tests or preparations PROPOSED, and possibilities without adequate support UNSUPPORTED, and retaining source and condition information with the labels.
actual_claim_wordings.191: The method of claim 186, comprising selecting component bounds L_i and U_i for the selected support; testing 0 <= L_i <= U_i <= 1 for every component and sum_i(L_i) <= 1 <= sum_i(U_i); when those tests are satisfied, constructing a preliminary nonnegative normalized witness z_i within the bounds by starting at z_i = L_i and allocating the residual 1-sum_i(L_i) in support order without exceeding any U_i until sum_i(z_i) = 1; and assigning as the positive target fractions of claim 186 a strictly positive normalized witness within those bounds, using the preliminary witness as that target only when every coordinate is positive and otherwise constructing a separate strictly positive witness before target assignment.
actual_claim_wordings.192: The method of claim 191, further comprising, for a box satisfying the tests of claim 191, determining strictly positive feasibility for the selected support by requiring U_i > 0 for every component; when sum_i(L_i) = 1, additionally requiring L_i > 0 for every component and using the lower-bound vector as the positive witness; and when sum_i(L_i) < 1, setting epsilon = min(min_i(U_i), (1-sum_i(L_i))/(2k)), replacing each lower bound by L'_i = max(L_i, epsilon), and constructing a strictly positive normalized witness by allocating the residual 1-sum_i(L'_i) within the unchanged upper bounds; and assigning the resulting positive witness as the target fractions of claim 186.
actual_claim_wordings.193: The method of claim 186, comprising selecting a k-component box with 0 <= L_i <= U_i <= 1; calculating b_i = max(1, ceiling(D L_i)) and c_i = min(D-k+1, floor(D U_i)) for D = 10^19; accepting the box as numerically feasible on the positive D-grid only when b_i <= c_i for every component and sum_i(b_i) <= D <= sum_i(c_i); and, on acceptance, constructing integers n_i within those bounds with sum_i(n_i) = D by residual allocation and assigning x_i = n_i/D as the positive normalized target fractions of claim 186.

composition.basis: Ideal principal-only elemental atomic-fraction basis; denominator is the declared six-principal atom subtotal. It is neither feed mass, volume, site fraction nor an exhaustive retained-product assay.
composition.constraints: Every assigned coordinate is positive; exact sum 1. Counts are mathematical bookkeeping and do not assign local order, site occupancy or a rod.

finite_principal_compatibility.condition: For a finite principal subtotal to have these exact fractions, N_P=1000*m with m>=1 integer and N_i=n_i*m. This is necessary and sufficient for count integrality alone.
finite_principal_compatibility.actual_principal_ratios: UNSUPPORTED; the target is not substituted for actual measured r_i
finite_principal_compatibility.decimal_grid: Primitive 1000 divides 10^19; grid numerators are n_i*10^16 and sum 10^19. Grid compatibility is not a physical preparation or precision result.

whole_inventory_transfer.actual_count_definitions: N_P=sum over principal labels N_i; N_R=sum over actually present labels outside that support; N=N_P+N_R. N_P>=1 and N_R>=0 are finite integers for the declared ordinary-atom inventory.
whole_inventory_transfer.actual_conditional_ratios: r_i=N_i/N_P; UNKNOWN and not replaced by r_target
whole_inventory_transfer.outside_principal_fractions: When N_R>0, separately identify all positive additional labels and y_j=N_j/N_R, with x_j=(1-f)*y_j. When N_R=0 there is no additional support and y is not evaluated.
whole_inventory_transfer.closure: Whole closure requires all positive retained labels/counts under one spatial and temporal boundary; an aggregate unknown remainder does not identify that support.
whole_inventory_transfer.residue_allocation: Allocate by elemental label, not process origin. Retained principal-element atoms change N_P and r_i; only atoms of labels outside the principal support enter N_R. Unknown process retention cannot be silently assigned to N_R or zero.
whole_inventory_transfer.conditional_exact_target_model: Only under the independent stipulation r_i=r_target, N_P=1000*m. A whole finite target then has principal counts n_i*m, extra subtotal R>=0 integer, total 1000*m+R and principal share1000*m/(1000*m+R). Actual R/labels/ratios remain unsupported.

mass_and_isotope_convention.status: CALCULATED symbolic relation only; numerical conversion unavailable without justified mass/isotope information
mass_and_isotope_convention.qualified_mass_requirement: Each populated elemental state needs a justified positive finite isotope-qualified effective mass M_i and the same explicit allocation/compatible-unit convention. Missing positive-population mass is not assigned zero.
mass_and_isotope_convention.whole_mass_fractions: w_i=a_i*M_i/sum over all populated j(a_j*M_j), using actual whole atom fractions a_i and complete mass allocation
mass_and_isotope_convention.distinct_principal_mass_share: f_mass=(sum over principal i N_i*M_i)/(sum over all populated j N_j*M_j); generally f_mass differs from atom share f. Whole principal w_i=f_mass*v_i_actual uses actual principal ratios, not the target by default.

additional_Al_calculation.evidence_status: CALCULATED; independently authored target branch, not a source-Al observation
additional_Al_calculation.interior_domain: 0<beta<1; this exact finite-count branch uses rational beta. Values outside[0,1] cannot be normalized nonnegative populations.
additional_Al_calculation.interior_target: Each existing principal fraction becomes (1-beta)*r_target_i; x_Al=beta. All seven coordinates are positive and sum 1.

closure_boundaries.beta0: Drop zero Al; return six principal labels.
closure_boundaries.beta1: Drop every zero principal coordinate; retain only Al with fraction 1. This one-label boundary is outside claim 1 k>=2, while independent record claim 186 does not itself impose that minimum.

exact_witness.proof: gcd(original n_i)=1 implies gcd(scaled principal counts)=L-1; gcd(1000,L-1)=1. Thus primitive denominator 1000L, also the LCM of reduced coordinate denominators.
exact_witness.below_grid: Al fraction 1/L is positive and below 10^-19; this calculated branch is outside that historical positive-floor grid but inside the unrestricted rational domain.
